title: Oven Roasted Algerian Lentil Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Algerian dish made with roasted French lentils and a blend of spices, perfect for a kid-friendly dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, toss the lentils with olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated
Spread the lentils in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes
In a large Dutch oven, combine the roasted lentils, diced tomatoes, and chicken broth
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the liquid has been absorbed
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving
Serve the tagine over couscous or rice, garnished with additional parsley if desired
